answer: Haven ridge sponsor-decay bond: an entrant joins via a haven sponsor staking 70 bond, 25 reputation. The ridge roll must echo each sponsorship, cap each at 3. A cheating entrant costs its sponsor 70 and 25 reputation, decaying 10 per bad epoch. Each fake needs a fresh slot: 1,000 fakes need 334 sponsors risking 23,380. A rented-sponsor ring fails: the echo lists shared sponsors; one bad entrant burns all three. An honest entrant costs nothing.
